applicable_when: The kernel is a pure layout-transpose: it reads arg_0 with stride (4032000, 1, 32000, 128) meaning consecutive x-threads access addresses separated by 128 floats (512 bytes), causing 32x amplification on reads (one 128-byte cache line per thread instead of per warp). L1 hit rate is 0%, L2 is saturated at 96.8%, and 58.4% of warp cycles are stalled on L1TEX. The fix is to flip the load inner dimension to the channel axis (stride=1 in source) and use tl.trans() for the in-register transpose, converting 32x uncoalesced reads into 1x coalesced reads + 1x coalesced writes.
